questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the nervous system'?
explanation: Neurology is correct - N-E-U-R-O-L-O-G-Y. Neurology is the branch of medicine dealing with the nervous system.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'relating to the heart'?
explanation: Cardiac is correct - C-A-R-D-I-A-C. Cardiac relates to the heart and its functions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a substance that kills bacteria'?
explanation: Antibiotic is correct - A-N-T-I-B-I-O-T-I-C. Antibiotics are medicines that destroy bacteria.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of living organisms'?
explanation: Biology is correct - B-I-O-L-O-G-Y. Biology is the science of life and living things.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a device for sending messages wirelessly'?
explanation: Transmitter is correct - T-R-A-N-S-M-I-T-T-E-R. A transmitter sends signals over a distance. Double T.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a disease that spreads quickly'?
explanation: Epidemic is correct - E-P-I-D-E-M-I-C. An epidemic is a widespread occurrence of a disease.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the outer protective layer of skin'?
explanation: Epidermis is correct - E-P-I-D-E-R-M-I-S. The epidermis is the outer layer of skin.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability to do work'?
explanation: Energy is correct - E-N-E-R-G-Y. Energy is the capacity to do work or cause change.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a device that controls electric flow'?
explanation: Resistor is correct - R-E-S-I-S-T-O-R. A resistor is a component that limits electrical current.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the branch of science dealing with chemicals'?
explanation: Chemistry is correct - C-H-E-M-I-S-T-R-Y. Chemistry is the science of substances and their reactions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a particle with no charge in an atom'?
explanation: Neutron is correct - N-E-U-T-R-O-N. A neutron is a subatomic particle with no electrical charge.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of turning food into energy'?
explanation: Metabolism is correct - M-E-T-A-B-O-L-I-S-M. Metabolism refers to chemical processes in the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a unit of digital information'?
explanation: Gigabyte is correct - G-I-G-A-B-Y-T-E. A gigabyte is a unit of digital data equal to one billion bytes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the universe'?
explanation: Cosmology is correct - C-O-S-M-O-L-O-G-Y. Cosmology is the science of the origin and structure of the universe.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the body immune response to a substance'?
explanation: Allergy is correct - A-L-L-E-R-G-Y. An allergy is a hypersensitive reaction of the immune system. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an instrument for measuring temperature'?
explanation: Thermometer is correct - T-H-E-R-M-O-M-E-T-E-R. A thermometer measures temperature.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of heredity and genes'?
explanation: Genetics is correct - G-E-N-E-T-I-C-S. Genetics is the study of genes and heredity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the surgical repair of the heart'?
explanation: Bypass is correct - B-Y-P-A-S-S. A bypass is a surgical procedure to redirect blood flow around a blockage. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the splitting of an atomic nucleus'?
explanation: Fission is correct - F-I-S-S-I-O-N. Nuclear fission is the splitting of a heavy atomic nucleus. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a network of interconnected computers'?
explanation: Internet is correct - I-N-T-E-R-N-E-T. The internet is a global network of computers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the branch of medicine for children'?
explanation: Paediatrics is correct - P-A-E-D-I-A-T-R-I-C-S. Paediatrics is the medical care of infants and children.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an instrument that magnifies small objects'?
explanation: Microscope is correct - M-I-C-R-O-S-C-O-P-E. A microscope magnifies objects too small to see with the naked eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of the atmosphere'?
explanation: Meteorology is correct - M-E-T-E-O-R-O-L-O-G-Y. Meteorology is the study of weather and the atmosphere.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the treatment of cancer using radiation'?
explanation: Radiotherapy is correct - R-A-D-I-O-T-H-E-R-A-P-Y. Radiotherapy uses radiation to treat cancer.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the mind and behavior'?
explanation: Psychology is correct - P-S-Y-C-H-O-L-O-G-Y. The P is silent. Psychology is the study of mind and behavior.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the conversion of light into electricity'?
explanation: Photovoltaic is correct - P-H-O-T-O-V-O-L-T-A-I-C. Photovoltaic cells convert sunlight into electricity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of heat and temperature'?
explanation: Thermodynamics is correct - T-H-E-R-M-O-D-Y-N-A-M-I-C-S. Thermodynamics studies relationships between heat, work, and energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a technique to view inside the body'?
explanation: Ultrasound is correct - U-L-T-R-A-S-O-U-N-D. Ultrasound uses sound waves to create images inside the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of making a copy of DNA'?
explanation: Replication is correct - R-E-P-L-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. DNA replication is the process of copying genetic information.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a medical scan using magnetic fields'?
explanation: Magnetic resonance is correct - M-A-G-N-E-T-I-C R-E-S-O-N-A-N-C-E. An MRI uses magnetic resonance to image the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of earthquakes'?
explanation: Seismology is correct - S-E-I-S-M-O-L-O-G-Y. Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ability of a material to conduct electricity'?
explanation: Conductivity is correct - C-O-N-D-U-C-T-I-V-I-T-Y. Conductivity measures how well a material conducts electricity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'tiny robots that work at the molecular level'?
explanation: Nanotechnology is correct - N-A-N-O-T-E-C-H-N-O-L-O-G-Y. Nanotechnology manipulates matter at the atomic scale.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of designing and building bridges'?
explanation: Structural engineering is correct - S-T-R-U-C-T-U-R-A-L E-N-G-I-N-E-E-R-I-N-G. Structural engineering designs load-bearing structures.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the measure of a substance acidity'?
explanation: pH level is correct - p-H L-E-V-E-L. The pH level measures how acidic or alkaline a substance is.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a type of wireless technology'?
explanation: Bluetooth is correct - B-L-U-E-T-O-O-T-H. Bluetooth is a wireless technology for short-range communication.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a material that does not conduct electricity'?
explanation: Insulator is correct - I-N-S-U-L-A-T-O-R. An insulator prevents the flow of electricity or heat.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a closed path for electricity'?
explanation: Circuit is correct - C-I-R-C-U-I-T. A circuit is a complete path around which electricity flows.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a type of particle accelerator'?
explanation: Cyclotron is correct - C-Y-C-L-O-T-R-O-N. A cyclotron is a particle accelerator used in nuclear physics.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the removal of a body organ'?
explanation: Extraction is correct - E-X-T-R-A-C-T-I-O-N. Extraction is the process of removing something.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a blood vessel carrying blood to the heart'?
explanation: Vein is correct - V-E-I-N. A vein is a blood vessel that carries blood toward the heart.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a chemical that speeds up a reaction'?
explanation: Catalyst is correct - C-A-T-A-L-Y-S-T. A catalyst increases the rate of a chemical reaction without being consumed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'an image taken by a camera'?
explanation: Photograph is correct - P-H-O-T-O-G-R-A-P-H. A photograph is an image produced by a camera.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the outer layer of Earth'?
explanation: Lithosphere is correct - L-I-T-H-O-S-P-H-E-R-E. The lithosphere is the solid outer crust of Earth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a type of energy from the sun'?
explanation: Solar is correct - S-O-L-A-R. Solar energy comes from the sun.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a unit of electrical pressure'?
explanation: Voltage is correct - V-O-L-T-A-G-E. Voltage measures the electrical pressure that drives a current.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of designing computer software'?
explanation: Programming is correct - P-R-O-G-R-A-M-M-I-N-G. Programming is writing instructions for computers. Double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the building block of all living things'?
explanation: Chromosome is correct - C-H-R-O-M-O-S-O-M-E. A chromosome carries genetic information in living cells.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a type of radiation from radioactive materials'?
explanation: Radioactive is correct - R-A-D-I-O-A-C-T-I-V-E. Radioactive materials emit radiation as their atoms decay.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of how drugs affect the body'?
explanation: Pharmacology is correct - P-H-A-R-M-A-C-O-L-O-G-Y. Pharmacology studies how drugs interact with biological systems.
